Ravi (SRE): Short follow-up from the DR postmortem. I distilled to five small handoffs. Reply with: owner | ETA (date) | done condition (one line). Keep it terse.

Ravi (SRE): Items: 1) routing canary + auto-fallback test; 2) nightly cross-region restore w/ checksum; 3) runbook: explicit KV priming + traffic gate; 4) game-day rota + war-room template; 5) recurrence feed -> triage board.

Hannah (NetEng): 1) Hannah | 2026-04-08 | canary PR + CI job that simulates region fail and proves failover <45s for test-prefix. Blocker: need ephemeral test prefix NET-4510.

Liu (Backups): 2) Liu | 2026-04-04 | nightly restore in staging + 5 consecutive checksum matches. Blocker: object-store read timeouts (ticket BACK-918).

Ravi (SRE): 3) Ravi | 2026-03-30 | runbook PR with KV priming step (synthetic warmup) + checklist for traffic-shift toggles. DONE when merged and linked in calendar invite.

Maya (Platform PM): 4 & 5) Maya | 2026-04-18 | game-day schedule + war-room template live, recurrence feed MVP (dashboard + weekly digest). DONE when invites sent and dashboard linked from triage. Blocker: need attendee confirmations.

Hannah (NetEng): sample canary command (dry-run):

```
./bgp-canary --prefix test-eu-03 --fail-region eu-west-1 --expect-redirect 40s --dry-run
```

Liu (Backups): nightly restore cron (example):

```
# nightly at 02:10 UTC
10 2 * * * /opt/redwood/bin/restore --snapshot latest --cluster staging --verify checksums --notify onfail
```

Ravi (SRE): ops rule: tag all PRs with `dr-postmortem-2026` and include one-line: owner | ETA | smoke-test | rollback. I'll spot-check before merge.

Hannah (NetEng): NET-4510 ticket created for ephemeral prefix. PR will reference it.

Liu (Backups): BACK-918 updated with logs; requested priority bump.

Maya (Platform PM): creating calendar stub now: "DR Game Day (warm-standby)" 2026-04-18. I'll seed invites and the war-room doc.

TaskBot: Reminder set: weekly follow-up in #incidents every Mon 09:00 UTC. Task created: DR-FOLLOWUP-2026-01.

Ravi (SRE): ok — owners, drop your PR/ticket links in the shared sheet and mark blockers. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/dr-2026-followups (internal). Ping me if anything slips >72h. :thumbsup:
